name: ordered-pairs
description:
Every ordered pair of two different items of a list: a table first, second («a», «b» → a b, b a).

Each item counts once, in the order of its first row; empty cells are no items. n items give n x (n - 1) pairs.
limit: the most pairs the result may hold; a larger result is refused before any is made.

Example: semkit read --text "диван" --text "кресло" ordered-pairs write -
-> диван, кресло; кресло, диван

The step makes a table of its result; it replaces the current table, its first text column is the working one.

options.name: --limit
options.description: the most pairs the result may hold; a larger result is refused before any is made.
